vo/m1.mp3.text: [fast, cocky] No, tell them nine sharp. I've got the deck, I've got the clicker. Brenda... today is MY day.

vo/m8a.mp3.text: Brenda, let me call you back.

vo/m8b.mp3.text: [irritated] What's 'it'? What's the 'it' you're looking for?

vo/l9.mp3.text: A blessing was extended. Customarily, there's an acknowledgment.

vo/m10.mp3.text: It's a reflex! It's just a thing people say.

vo/m12.mp3.text: Well, I didn't ask for it.

vo/l11.mp3.text: [calm, firm] I don't say things. I blessed you. I reached in, and I gave you some of mine.

vo/l13.mp3.text: Nobody asks. That's what makes it a gift.

vo/m14.mp3.text: [sarcastic] Okay. Well. I'm good. I'm all set on blessings.

vo/l17.mp3.text: Then I'll be taking it back.

vo/m18.mp3.text: [laughing] You'll be... how do you take back a...

vo/m24a.mp3.text: [reading aloud] Hey bud. Going with Greg for the presentation. Also, Greg's taking your office. Also, your chair.

vo/u25.mp3.text: [hushed] Don't stare, darling. He's got no blessing.

vo/o29.mp3.text: [cheerful] Okay! Love you. Well... you know.

vo/o28.mp3.text: [warm] Marcus, sweetheart. I don't know why, but I just had the strongest urge to call and tell you... I've always preferred your brother.

vo/m30.mp3.text: [frantic] Okay. Okay! Thank you. THANK you. There.

vo/m34.mp3.text: [strained politeness] Thank you for blessing me, sir, when I sneezed. Can I have it back?

vo/l35.mp3.text: It's not that simple. The original was complimentary. This would be a re-blessing.

vo/l38.mp3.text: In the past twelve months, have you declined any other courtesies?

vo/m39.mp3.text: [reluctant] ...A guy held a door. I was on my phone.

vo/m43.mp3.text: [spooked, whispering] How do you know my name?

vo/m46.mp3.text: [rushed] Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

vo/l45.mp3.text: I'll need three thank-yous. One for the original. One for my time. And one in advance.

vo/l47.mp3.text: Those were to the pavement. In my eyes.

vo/l51.mp3.text: Oh, I can't bless you. You'd have to sneeze.

vo/l52.mp3.text: And my bus is in one minute.

vo/l54.mp3.text: I'm not blessing that. That was a man saying achoo.

vo/m55.mp3.text: [desperate] Wait, wait, wait! It's coming! Ah... AH... AAAH...

vo/m59.mp3.text: [bright] Brenda! Hey. No, no. Now's perfect.
